svg.text: STRINGBUILDER GROWTH: A NEW ARRAY, NEVER A LONGER ONE
JDK 21. Capacities from CapacityGrowth.java, byte arrays from Inflation.java (reflection).
value now points at the new array
34 bytes copied, 1 written, 35 spare. Each growth copies everything written so far, but growths get rarer as it doubles
Capacity in chars after each growth, appending one char at a time
INFLATION: one char outside Latin-1 converts the whole buffer
after append("Caf") and append('é'): é is U+00E9, still one byte
UTF16, coder 1: the same 16 chars in byte[32]
two bytes per char; capacity() still says 16
The builder stays UTF16 after the ₹ is deleted; toString() still produces a compact LATIN1 String when it can.
